data.gender_notes: Drayansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Drayansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'drayati' which means 'to bestow grace'. This name is associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who is known for his grace and protection. Drayansh is believed to bring good fortune and blessings to the child. The name Drayansh carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Drayansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
